meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-07-29 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c3d: level with previous night (55) · +1 vs 7-day avg (54)
en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Two short nights back to back, and this one handed back the depth. Lights out at 23:52 — a third straight night past 23:30 — and the night closed at 5h27, 48 minutes under the 6h 15m average and the shortest ordinary night since Friday's 4h42. Deep sleep fell to 55 minutes from 123 the night before: that rebound has been spent, and 196 minutes of light sleep is what filled the gap. REM held up at 76m and awake time stayed low at 13m, so the night was efficient — just too short. Score 72, Garmin's 'fair'. The autonomics are the better half of the story: HRV climbed back to 42, +5 on yesterday's window low, and average stress fell to 20, the calmest reading of the seven days. RHR is unchanged at 55, still the window high, and is the one marker yet to turn. Recovering HRV, calm stress, accumulating sleep debt — that is the expected mix the morning after Tuesday's hack squat, where the top set jumped to 185 kg × 6 from 160 kg × 10 the week before. Readiness is moderate at 63. Swim intervals are on today and they are the right call: aerobic, low joint cost, and the session that has been traded away two weeks running. Swim it at Monday's 2.2 km template rather than extending it. The lever that matters is tonight's bedtime — under 23:00 would give the first night back over 6h30 in four days. Note the chart still skips Sun 26: that evening has no record, so the seven bars run Tue 21 to Tue 28.

hr.c3d: isto kao prethodna noć (55) · +1 vs 7-dnevni prosjek (54)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Dvije kratke noći zaredom, a ova je vratila dubinu. Gašenje svjetla u 23:52 — treća noć zaredom nakon 23:30 — pa je noć završila na 5h27, 48 minuta ispod prosjeka od 6h 15m i najkraća redovna noć od petkovih 4h42. Duboki san pao je na 55 minuta s 123 prethodne noći: taj je odskok potrošen, a prazninu je popunilo 196 minuta lakog sna. REM se održao na 76m, a budnost je ostala niska na 13m — noć je bila učinkovita, samo prekratka. Ocjena 72, Garminovo 'solidno'. Autonomika je bolji dio priče: HRV se popeo natrag na 42, +5 na jučerašnji minimum prozora, a prosječni stres pao je na 20, najmirnije očitanje u sedam dana. RHR je nepromijenjen na 55, i dalje najviši u prozoru — jedini pokazatelj koji se još nije okrenuo. Oporavak HRV-a, miran stres i rastući dug sna očekivana su kombinacija jutro nakon utorkovog hack squata, gdje je najteža serija skočila na 185 kg × 6 sa 160 kg × 10 tjedan ranije. Spremnost je umjerena — 63. Bazenski intervali su danas na rasporedu i to je pravi izbor: aerobno, malo opterećenja za zglobove, i upravo je to trening koji se već dva tjedna zaredom mijenja za nešto drugo. Odradi ga po ponedjeljkovom predlošku od 2,2 km, bez produljivanja. Poluga koja je važna je večerašnje lijeganje — ispod 23:00 dalo bi prvu noć preko 6h30 u četiri dana. Primijeti da graf i dalje preskače Ned 26: ta večer nema zapisa, pa sedam stupaca ide od Uto 21 do Uto 28.
